goal: Provide a reusable way to determine whether a value is a plausibly valid email address. Validation should return a clear valid-or-invalid result without contacting external services.

alternatives.title: Practical pattern validation
tradeoffs: May reject unusual but technically valid addresses or accept rare malformed cases.
Keeps validation small, fast, predictable, and dependency-free.

alternatives.title: Standards-oriented email parser
tradeoffs: Adds implementation complexity or a dependency and may accept unfamiliar address forms.
Handles more RFC-valid edge cases and provides stronger syntax interpretation.

self_critique.weakest_point: The phrase practical email syntax still leaves exact edge-case behavior unspecified.
self_critique.cut_or_change: If the product needs unusual internationalized or quoted addresses, replace the practical-pattern assumption with an explicit supported-address policy.
